displayNameCn: 阿拔斯·本·阿卜杜勒·穆塔利卜
fullNameCn: 阿拔斯·本·阿卜杜勒·穆塔利卜
primaryTitle: Companion of Muhammad and ancestor of the Abbasids
primaryTitleCn: 穆罕默德叔父、圣门弟子及阿拔斯王朝祖先

events.label: Was captured by the Muslims at the Battle of Badr
events.labelCn: 在白德尔战役中被穆斯林俘虏
events.note: Later traditions disagree over whether he had already secretly sympathized with Islam.

events.label: Openly joined Muhammad before or at the conquest of Mecca
events.labelCn: 在麦加征服前后公开加入穆罕默德阵营
events.note: Public conversion is clear by the conquest, though family traditions claim an earlier secret conversion.

events.label: Remained with Muhammad during the crisis at Ḥunayn
events.labelCn: 侯奈因战役危急时仍留在穆罕默德身边
events.note: He is remembered among those who stayed near Muhammad and helped rally the army.

events.label: Became a senior member of the Prophet's family after Muhammad's death
events.labelCn: 穆罕默德去世后成为先知家族的重要长辈
events.note: Later Abbasid legitimacy placed exceptional emphasis on descent from him.

events.label: Died in Medina
events.note: His descendants later formed the genealogical basis of the Abbasid house.

sourceNote: Ibn Isḥāq/Ibn Hishām; al-Ṭabarī; al-Balādhurī; Tayeb El-Hibri; Hugh Kennedy; Wikipedia as supplementary index.
notes:
Muhammad's paternal uncle and the eponymous ancestor used by the Abbasids; this batch intentionally stops that line here.

Confidence / caveats: Conversion date is disputed and later Abbasid political memory shaped traditions about him. Exact birth year is uncertain.

Unlinked family: mother: Nutayla bint Janāb; spouse: Lubāba al-Kubrā bint al-Ḥārith; child: ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-ʿAbbās; child: al-Faḍl ibn al-ʿAbbās; child: Qutham ibn al-ʿAbbās; child: ʿUbayd Allāh ibn al-ʿAbbās
